q: The Borel hierarchy on a Polish space X starts with open and closed sets and is built by taking countable unions (Σ⁰_α) and complements (Π⁰_α). The first levels are Σ⁰₁ = open, Π⁰₁ = closed, Σ⁰₂ =
opts: F_σ (countable union of closed sets) = {∪ Fₙ : Fₙ closed}
exp: Σ⁰₂ = F_σ (countable unions of closed sets). Π⁰₂ = G_δ (countable intersections of open sets). The key examples: ℚ is F_σ in ℝ (not G_δ by Baire), ℝ\ℚ is G_δ (countable intersection of dense open sets). The hierarchy is strict (each class is strictly larger than all previous ones).
